newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian police officer killed on Gaza border.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian police officer killed on Gaza border.

text.p: An Egyptian police major was shot dead on the border with the Gaza Strip on Thursday during clashes between Israelis and Palestinians, the Egyptian Interior Ministry said.
The officer, Major Muawwad Abdellatif Abu Galil, a police detective based in North Sinai, was hit at the Rafah checkpoint on the Egyptian side of the border, a statement said.
The statement did not say which side in the clashes might have fired the bullet which killed him or whether the Egyptians suspected the shooting was deliberate.
